summary: Several metrics show abrupt deviations around 14:11‑14:12 UTC: memory usage, GC time and upload count spike sharply, an OOM kill appears, and memory usage strongly correlates with GC time over the observed window.

evidence.interpretation: RSS memory rose to 995 MB, far above the baseline mean of ~85 MB (z‑score > 380).
GC pause time jumped to 520 ms versus a baseline mean of ~4.6 ms (z‑score > 1300).
Active uploads increased to 15, more than double the baseline average of ~6.3 (z‑score ≈ 7).
One OOM kill was recorded at 14:12 UTC, whereas the prior baseline recorded zero kills.
Memory RSS and GC time exhibit a strong positive Pearson correlation (r≈0.90) over the 7‑sample window.
